::: {.bnr-manual-flag .bnr-manual-flag--operations}
Operations Manual
:::

**Owner:** BNR Lead.

## Purpose

This page separates responsibility for preparing work from authority to approve and release it. One person may hold more than one role where BNR staffing requires this, but each decision must still be completed deliberately and recorded.

## Core roles

| Role | Main responsibility | 
|--|----|
| **BNR Lead** | Owns registry operations, priorities and final governance | 
| **BNR Analyst** | Runs analytical workflows and assesses statistical plausibility | 
| **BNR Developer** | Maintains the analytical and publishing environment | 
| **Abstractor / registry officer** | Identifies potential cases, reviews sources and maintains REDCap records | 
| **Clinical reviewer** | Resolves clinical classification questions requiring clinical judgement |
| **Approver** | Records approval of the exact analytically and disclosure-reviewed payload | 
| **Publisher** | Promotes only an approved package and updates the Info-Hub | 

The approver is likely to be either the BNR Lead or the BNR Analyst. The analyst, approver and publisher may be the same authorised person, but calculation, approval and publication remain separate actions.
